target.runtime: AI Builder embedded app-private Android/Bionic runtime
target.prefixPolicy: Must match the prefix returned by the installed AI Builder runtime; supply explicitly to the forked package-builder properties. Do not guess or hardcode a Termux path.

upstreamRecipeSource.revisionVerification: Unsigned upstream commit; pinning identifies source but is not a repository-signature trust decision.
upstreamRecipeSource.usage: Use recipes as source references only. No upstream binary package, Termux apt feed, or PocketForge artifact is used.

packageBuilderEnvironment.hostImage: Ubuntu 26.04 from the pinned revision Dockerfile; currently a mutable tag, not an immutable image digest
packageBuilderEnvironment.note: These are upstream package-builder inputs, not a verified runtime Android SDK/NDK for AI Builder.

candidatePackageRoots.name: nodejs-lts
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: JavaScript runtime for React Native/Expo tooling
candidatePackageRoots.notes: Upstream recipe builds for Android/Bionic and ARM64. It separates npm from nodejs-lts beginning with 24.13.0; recipe also downloads pinned ICU and a host LLVM archive. A source comment says one-architecture build can take about two hours.

candidatePackageRoots.name: npm
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Package manager required separately by the pinned nodejs-lts recipe
candidatePackageRoots.notes: Recipe declares nodejs | nodejs-lts dependency; the upstream recipe value is retained as declared, not independently rehashed here.

candidatePackageRoots.name: openjdk-17
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Java runtime/compiler candidate for Gradle/Android builds
candidatePackageRoots.notes: Recipe links against Bionic-specific libraries and embeds prefix-dependent RPATH and JAVA_HOME paths. Package compatibility requires rebuilding with the exact app prefix and auditing every path and maintainer script.

candidatePackageRoots.name: python
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Python for native-module build helpers such as node-gyp
candidatePackageRoots.notes: Both source inputs and checksums are taken from the pinned recipe.

candidatePackageRoots.name: cmake
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Native module and NDK project builds

candidatePackageRoots.name: git
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Fetch Git-based project dependencies when required

candidatePackageRoots.name: pkg-config
candidatePackageRoots.purpose: Native library discovery for node-gyp/CMake projects

candidateStatus: These are pinned candidate roots, not a proven minimal dependency closure and not installable artifacts. Dependencies must be resolved from the same source revision and then captured in a generated lock with hashes. Exact app-prefix compatibility remains untested.

androidBuildSupport.reactNativeMinimumNode: 20.19.4 (v24.18.0 is a candidate satisfying this numeric minimum)

historicalAiBuilderHostBuild.scope: Historical Linux-host build evidence in project history only; not v475 or on-device evidence. Keep each project's checked-in wrapper/settings as source of truth.

androidBuildSupport.androidArmBionicHostStatus: UNVERIFIED. Official Android Studio Linux requirements do not establish support for ARM64/Bionic as a command-line SDK/AGP host. Do not claim an APK build path until sdkmanager, Gradle, AGP, aapt2, D8, apksigner, and NDK tools are executed on the actual AI Builder device.

provisioningDesign.distribution: Local/offline signed repository only after package and target-device validation
provisioningDesign.initialInstall: Separate, explicitly reviewed bootstrap step; runtime.packages remains read-only in v476
offlineRequirements: Android SDK platform/build-tools/NDK archives separately provisioned under their licenses
project Gradle wrapper distribution and checksum
Maven/Google Maven artifacts required by each project
npm/pnpm dependency tarballs and any Git-based dependencies
provisioningDesign.projectDataRule: Keep projects persistent only at /storage/emulated/0/AIBuilderTermux; never copy project files into the private package prefix.
